name: Black Solitaire
rangeDescription: West slope of western andes of colombia (chocó) and northwestern ecuador
description: This striking thrush is unmistakable if seen well: mostly jet black with a white cheek, white tuft under the shoulder, and white outer tail feathers (easily visible from below). Also note red eye and orange lower mandible.

name: Baudo Oropendola
rangeDescription: Northeastern colombia (northern chocó)
description: This impressively large and colorful oropendola is found only in lowland and foothill rainforest in northwestern Colombia. Its salmon-colored cheek patches along with chestnut back and belly distinguish it from Black Oropendola; also note the yellow tail and orange bill tip.

name: Ankober Serin
rangeDescription: Montane scrub of central ethiopia
description: A small seedeater of the Ethiopian highlands. The back and tail are brown and the head and underparts are heavily streaked.

name: White-tufted Honeyeater
rangeDescription: Lesser sundas (wetar to tanimbar and kai islands)
description: A drab olive-brown sparrow-sized songbird with a downcurved bill, dark speckling on the chest, and a small white cheek patch. Juvenile lacks speckling and has pink cheek skin.

name: Bolivian Warbling Finch
rangeDescription: Andes of bolivia and adjacent northwestern argentina (jujuy)
description: Striking tanager of open woodland and scrub in high elevations of the east slope of the Andes in central and southern Bolivia and extreme NW Argentina; including agricultural lands, and open Polylepis woodland. From Black-and-chestnut Warbling-Finch by white throat and paler underparts in Bolivian.

name: Asian Houbara
rangeDescription: Nile valley of egypt to arabian peninsula and pakistan
description: A medium-to-large bustard; significantly smaller than Great Bustard, but larger than Little Bustard. Overall tones are rather pale sandy.

name: Chestnut-backed Laughingthrush
rangeDescription: Lowlands of northeastern india (arunachal pradesh) to northern myanmar
description: A myna-sized bird with a large white cheek patch and a black forehead, chin, and throat. Note the gray belly, the reddish back, and a small white patch on the forehead.

name: Asian Emerald Cuckoo
rangeDescription: India to southern china, southeastern asia, sumatra, and andaman and nicobar islands
description: Stunning jewel of a bird, found in dense forests. Males have vivid, electric green upperparts and black-and-white striped underparts.

name: Red-collared Lorikeet
rangeDescription: Northern australia (kimberley region to gulf of carpenteria)
description: Large lorikeet. Very colorful, with a bright orange breast and neck, blue/black belly and head, and red bill.

name: Aztec Thrush
rangeDescription: Oak-pine forest of western and central mexico (sonora to oaxaca)
description: Rather stocky, boldly patterned thrush of highland pine-oak and fir forest. Endemic to western and central Mexico.

name: Plumed Egret
rangeDescription: Eastern indonesia, new guinea, and australia
description: A stocky egret that is larger than Eastern Cattle and Little Egrets, but smaller than the Great Egret. Often confusing and difficult to identify, this bird is truly intermediate between potential confusion species.

name: Abyssinian Longclaw
rangeDescription: High grassland of ethiopia
description: A large and relatively colorful member of the pipit family. Note the black necklace, orange throat, and partially yellow eye-stripe.

name: Barred Laughingthrush
rangeDescription: South-central china (southern gansu, southern shaanxi and western sichuan)
description: Pale brown laughingthrush with a pale face, black barring on the back, and a blue-gray wing panel. Handsome but shy and inconspicuous, foraging quietly on the ground and in shrubbery and thickets.

name: Spot-tailed Antwren
rangeDescription: Eastern venezuela to the guianas and northeastern amazonian brazil
description: Small antbird of rainforest canopy; somewhat more common in forests with sandy soils. From below, note clean white underparts and heavy bill.

name: Pallas's Leaf Warbler
rangeDescription: Coniferous forest and taiga of eastern asia; winters to indochina
description: Tiny, chunky, sprightly warbler with a short tail and a big head. Strong head pattern: three bright yellow stripes on an olive green head.

name: Stierling's Woodpecker
rangeDescription: Southern tanzania to northern mozambique and southern malawi; eastern zambia?
description: A medium-sized woodpecker with pale underparts that are covered with dark arrow-shaped markings. Has a bold facial pattern: crown is dark in the female and dark (forecrown) and red (hindcrown) in the male.

name: Sooty Tyrannulet
rangeDescription: Southeastern bolivia to central argentina, eastern paraguay, uruguay, and southern brazil
description: A very small and long-tailed flycatcher with fairly uniformly dark-gray plumage. It has a dark bill and legs with a slightly paler throat and two indistinct wingbars.

name: Rufous-winged Buzzard
rangeDescription: Savanna and woodland of southeastern asia, java, and sulawesi
description: A rather small hawk with demonic-looking pale eyes. Grayish-brown with a white belly and warmer cinnamon-brown tones in the wings and tail that are most prominent when the bird is in flight.

name: Tanzanian Illadopsis
rangeDescription: Southern kenya to northeastern tanzania, eastern tanzania (pugu hills), and zanzibar
description: A chunky, mid-sized, remarkably drab babbler with a white throat and grayish breast. Found in the understory of moist forest at low and middle elevations, usually in small groups.

name: Red-tailed Vanga
rangeDescription: Forested regions of madagascar
description: Small vanga that is built like a chickadee or tit. Male is colorful and female plain brownish.
